lead.subhead: Career highs, eight blocks, and the winning free throw with 24 seconds left. Meanwhile the 6-2 Bears get to work for Sunday night against Tampa Bay.

articles.hed: A Night for the Record Books
articles.body: Victor Wembanyama posted 52 points, 24 rebounds and eight blocks in a 112-111 win over Dallas, joining Bob McAdoo as the only players with 50, 20 and five blocks in a game. Luka Doncic added 40 for the Lakers, his sixth straight game of 35 or more.

Chicago put DT Kentavius Street on injured reserve and LT Braxton Jones is done for the year after knee surgery. Caleb Williams has 860 yards, four TDs and no picks over his last three games heading into the Bucs matchup at Soldier Field.

mindset.body: Jeffery Simmons was traded on Thursday and three days later he was sacking the Super Bowl champs on his fourth snap in a Bears uniform. No settling-in period, no excuses about a new playbook. Today, whatever's new or unfamiliar on your plate, don't wait to feel ready. Make your first rep count. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Thursday, the day of Jupiter: run this right after Morning Charge. Around 45° with drizzle possible, so keep the RipStick finisher in the driveway only if it's dry. Big, strong reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Apple opens Siri AI to every app developer
items.body: A developer preview in the iOS 27.3 betas lets apps plug content and actions into Siri through App Intents, with 'skills' that chain several steps into one request.
An open-source prototype that uses cryptographic proofs to verify a reply really came from the model a provider claims, without revealing the weights. Still experimental.

items.hed: OpenAI tightens security; xAI swaps Grok Imagine API models
items.body: OpenAI brought in Cathedral Systems for a security sprint and showed a Codex device designed by GPT-6 Astra in under a week. xAI now serves its quality and pro image API calls with a cheaper Grok Imagine Image 2.0 setting.
Career highs in points and boards plus eight blocks, and the winning free throw with 24.2 seconds left. San Antonio has won six straight.

items.hed: Klay's corner three wins it in OT
items.body: Klay Thompson hit the game-winner with one second left for 30 points as Miami came back from 20 down to beat the Clippers 117-116.
New York opened 43-21 in the first quarter. Chicago has lost five straight and sits at 1-7.

items.hed: Bears put Kentavius Street on IR
items.body: Street left the Seattle win with a knee injury and is likely done for the year. TE Stephen Carlson was promoted to the active roster.

items.hed: Braxton Jones out for the season
items.body: The left tackle had season-ending knee surgery Tuesday. Theo Benedet stays at left tackle.

items.hed: Injury watch before Sunday night vs. Tampa
items.body: Kyle Monangai (toe), Grady Jarrett (groin) and Theo Benedet (shoulder) did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough.

items.body: Shane Mosley Jr. faces Denzel Bentley in Saturday's co-main in London. Bentley was stripped, so no belt is on the line.

Thursday belongs to Jupiter, Zeus to the Greeks: king of the gods, ruler of expansion, generosity and rightful authority. Old magicians chose it for petitions, growth and big asks. Ask for the bigger thing today.
The Gnostics called the divine fullness the Pleroma, the source every spark of light came from. Their path was remembering that you carry a piece of it. Act like it.
The medieval mystic taught that God is found in the ground of the soul, reached by letting go of clutter. Cut one distraction today and see what's underneath.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established' (Proverbs 15:22). Big plans die in one head. Jupiter's day is for widening the circle: run your plan past someone sharp before you commit.
